title: Intraday Price Reversals in the US Stock Index Futures Market: A 15-Year Study
about: Opening-shock reversals in US stock-index futures.
findings: Authors report reversals in 1987–2002, but bid–ask adjustments sharply weaken significance; consistent net profitability is unresolved.
mechanism: Liquidity provision after an opening overreaction is plausible, not new verified alpha.
